properties.description:
THE THEME, Anthony's thread of 2026-10-29: unfinished proofs (Navier–Stokes, the Riemann Hypothesis) → his thesis that a person, an ordinary agent and reflow2 can close proof holes because the structure is written down → general intelligence as cognition (the agent) plus memory (reflow2) → recall is the hard part of a two-part mind → cues are the messages on the interface that improve recall → the earlier tool-usage work (pruning, process steps) refined by the cue counts → and, after the pilot, WHERE structure starts to matter: size against context, and a graph against notes at one reading budget. One question runs through all of it: does writing the work down in reflow2 let an ordinary agent do what it cannot do holding everything in its head, and does it remember to use what is written?

NINE INCREMENTS (each its own planned epoch, belonging to this one), in order of work, as two tracks after 8:
1. epoch:planned-recall-pilot-before — the pilot, BEFORE numbers. Scored 2026-10-29 (reflow2 25, notes 24.5, summary 13.5, read-all 25); the cue-following count is still owed before it arrives.
8. epoch:planned-structure-against-notes-at-one-reading-budget — (b) one reading budget, (c) can a person trace why, (d) structuring costed apart from using. NEXT.
MEASUREMENT AND PROOF TRACK: 9. epoch:planned-size-sweep-where-structure-starts-to-matter → 4. epoch:planned-proof-calibration-on-a-known-answer → 5. epoch:planned-one-named-hole-in-a-proof-map.
CUES AND TOOLS TRACK: 2. epoch:planned-cues-reach-the-agent-and-are-counted → 3. epoch:planned-recall-pilot-after → 7. epoch:planned-the-tool-surface-refined-from-the-counts → 6. epoch:planned-a-cue-is-one-named-message.
(The numbers are the order the increments were planned in, not the order of work.)

FORCED: 1→2, 2→3, 2→7, 2→6 (the cue before/after and everything built on the counts); 1→8 (same material and harness); 4→5 (his word: calibration first). PREFERENCE: 8→2 (whether structure helps shapes what the cue work is worth); 8→9 (8 says how large a difference to look for); 9→4 and 3→4 (proofs are the large tangled structures the sweep is about, and they use the improved cues); 3→7→6.

WHAT IS NOT IN IT: an attempt on the whole Riemann Hypothesis or Navier–Stokes problem ("map, not attempt" stands); a formal proof checker; associative cues and visual cues on flo2 pages; deleting any tool without a refusing-stub release first; any claim about AGI beyond what the measurements show.

THE RECORDS IT GATHERS: the day's ideas with their roads not taken (proof thesis, map to attempt, the hole loop, trust, cognition plus memory, cues, where structure starts to matter); reflow2:dec:the-cognition-plus-memory-thesis-is-tested-by-measurement-first; the recall, cue and measurement requirements; the pilot's predictions and its scored result; and for the tool surface reflow2:dec:idea-prune-the-tool-surface-to-an-orthogonal-essential-set, reflow2:dec:bl-155, the hub's usage baseline and 83d2b0775fe79af6:dec:idea-process-steps-are-not-stand-alone-tools. Related: the proof ladder (reflow2:dec:idea-navier-stokes-as-a-trial-of-designing-a-proof).
